arStrings.szText: To tamper with fate is to invite its end.

A grisly death in Vision's End matches the image painted on a foreboding urn. Too similar to be mere coincidence.

I should search around town for anyone who may be familiar with the victim or this unsettling urn.
Speak with Rhea and the local youths
Speak with Rhea and the local youths

A group of youths performed a "fate urn" ceremony and have been cursed—their horrible deaths portended by mysterious urns created by the ritual. The curse has already claimed one youth and sent another—Lycus—to hide where fate cannot find him.

I need to find Lycus and the source of this curse before it sows more death in Philios.

The fate urn curse claimed Lycus, matching his death to the depiction on his urn. I must find the source of the curse before the remaining youths' ill fates can come to pass.

Rhea has gone to Oracle Cyra for guidance. Perhaps she can help find the root of this curse.

Oracle Cyra says the fate urns' creator is pulling the strings of the curse, causing the youths to suffer the fates depicted on their urns. She also spoke of a fifth urn being created—its owner yet unknown.
